ucs.title: [LLM] Rhysida SILENTKILL.ps1 EDR/AV-termination chain on freshly-staged host
ucs.description: Hunts the Rhysida-bespoke 'SILENTKILL.ps1' PowerShell script (and inline variants) that walks a hard-coded list of AV/EDR processes + services and stops them as a pre-encryption staging step. CISA/FBI advisory AA23-319A flags this script and its terminate-list (Defender, MsMpEng, Sophos, SentinelOne, CarbonBlack, ESET, etc.) as a Rhysida signature distinct from other big-game crews.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="powershell.exe" OR Processes.process_name="pwsh.exe") AND (Processes.process="*silentkill*" OR (Processes.process="*Stop-Process*" AND (Processes.process="*Defender*" OR Processes.process="*MsMpEng*" OR Processes.process="*Sense*" OR Processes.process="*Sophos*" OR Processes.process="*SentinelOne*" OR Processes.process="*CarbonBlack*" OR Processes.process="*CrowdStrike*" OR Processes.process="*CylanceSvc*" OR Processes.process="*ESET*" OR Processes.process="*Trend*" OR Processes.process="*McAfee*" OR Processes.process="*Bitdefender*")) OR (Processes.process="*wevtutil*" AND Processes.process="*cl*")) by host Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where user!="SYSTEM" AND NOT match(user,".*\$$") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let AvTerminateList = dynamic(["MsMpEng","WinDefend","Sense","SecurityHealthService","SophosFS","SAVService","SentinelAgent","SentinelOne","CarbonBlack","CSFalconService","CSAgent","CylanceSvc","ESET","ekrn","TrendMicro","McAfee","masvc","Bitdefender","vsserv"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("silentkill","SilentKill")
      or (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Stop-Process","Stop-Service","taskkill") 
          and ProcessCommandLine has_any (AvTerminateList))
      or (ProcessCommandLine has "wevtutil" and ProcessCommandLine has "cl ")
| extend DecodedCmd = iff(ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc","-EncodedCommand"),
                          base64_decode_tostring(extract(@"(?i)-(?:e(?:nc(?:odedcommand)?)?)\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,})", 1, ProcessCommandLine)),
                          "")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          DecodedCmd, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let AvTerminateList = dynamic(["MsMpEng","WinDefend","Sense","SecurityHealthService","SophosFS","SAVService","SentinelAgent","SentinelOne","CarbonBlack","CSFalconService","CSAgent","CylanceSvc","ESET","ekrn","TrendMicro","McAfee","masvc","Bitdefender","vsserv"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\pwsh.exe"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where CommandLine has_any ("silentkill","SilentKill")
      or (CommandLine has_any ("Stop-Process","Stop-Service","taskkill") 
          and CommandLine has_any (AvTerminateList))
      or (CommandLine has "wevtutil" and CommandLine has "cl ")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Rhysida SILENTKILL.ps1 EDR/AV termination chain
id: 7a4f6d4e-9a91-4f63-bf2d-rhysida0001
status: experimental
description: Detects the Rhysida-bespoke SILENTKILL.ps1 helper (and inline variants) that mass-stops AV/EDR processes and services prior to ransomware deployment.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-319a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1070.001
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_ps:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  selection_named:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'silentkill'
      - 'SilentKill'
  selection_kill:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Stop-Process'
      - 'Stop-Service'
      - 'taskkill'
  selection_targets:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'MsMpEng'
      - 'WinDefend'
      - 'Sense'
      - 'Sophos'
      - 'SentinelOne'
      - 'CarbonBlack'
      - 'CSFalconService'
      - 'CylanceSvc'
      - 'ekrn'
      - 'TrendMicro'
      - 'McAfee'
      - 'Bitdefender'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_ps and (selection_named or (selection_kill and selection_targets)) and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Approved EDR migration / uninstall scripted by IT (correlate with change-management ticket)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe) AND ( @CommandLine:(*silentkill* OR *SilentKill* OR *SILENTKILL*) OR ( @CommandLine:(*Stop-Process* OR *Stop-Service* OR *taskkill*) AND @CommandLine:(*MsMpEng* OR *WinDefend* OR *Sense* OR *Sophos* OR *SentinelOne* OR *CarbonBlack* OR *CSFalconService* OR *CylanceSvc* OR *ekrn* OR *TrendMicro* OR *McAfee* OR *Bitdefender*) ) OR ( @CommandLine:*wevtutil* AND @CommandLine:*\ cl\ * ) ) AND -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| (CommandLine=/silentkill/i
   OR (CommandLine=/(Stop-Process|Stop-Service|taskkill)/i
       AND CommandLine=/(MsMpEng|WinDefend|Sense|Sophos|SentinelOne|CarbonBlack|CSFalconService|CSAgent|CylanceSvc|ekrn|TrendMicro|McAfee|Bitdefender|vsserv)/i)
   OR (CommandLine=/wevtutil/i AND CommandLine=/\bcl\b/i))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName], function=[count(), collect(CommandLine, separator=" || "), min(@timestamp), max(@timestamp)])
ucs.rationale: SILENTKILL.ps1 is a Rhysida-specific helper called out by name in CISA AA23-319A; the combination of (a) a verbatim string match on silentkill, (b) PowerShell stopping ≥1 AV/EDR target from the Rhysida hard-coded list, and (c) co-occurring wevtutil log-clearing distinguishes this from generic 'PowerShell + Stop-Process' noise. Other big-game crews (LockBit, BlackCat, Black Basta) use their own kil
_sigma_issues: sigma parse error: Sigma rule identifier must be an UUID

ucs.title: [LLM] Rhysida encryption burst + CriticalBreachDetected.pdf ransom note drop
ucs.description: Detects the late-stage Rhysida ransomware execution: a single host writing >50 files with the .rhysida extension within a short window, and/or dropping the actor-bespoke ransom note named CriticalBreachDetected.pdf in user/desktop directories. Both the extension and the note filename are Rhysida-specific IOCs (Vice Society lineage / CISA AA23-319A).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count as file_count min(_time) as firstSeen max(_time) as lastSeen values(Filesystem.file_path) as sample_paths values(Filesystem.process_name) as encryptor from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action=created AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.rhysida" OR Filesystem.file_name="CriticalBreachDetected.pdf") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user span=5m | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where file_count > 50 OR like(sample_paths, "%CriticalBreachDetected.pdf%") | sort - lastSeen
ucs.kql:
let WindowMinutes = 5m;
let EncryptionBurstThreshold = 50;
let rhysida = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(1d)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where FileName endswith ".rhysida"
          or (FileName =~ "CriticalBreachDetected.pdf" and FolderPath !has "\\Windows\\")
    | extend Bucket = bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes);
rhysida
| summarize EncryptedFiles = countif(FileName endswith ".rhysida"),
            NoteDropped    = countif(FileName =~ "CriticalBreachDetected.pdf"),
            FirstSeen      = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen       = max(Timestamp),
            Encryptor      = any(InitiatingProcessFileName),
            EncryptorCmd   = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
            EncryptorSHA   = any(InitiatingProcessSHA256),
            ParentProc     = any(InitiatingProcessParentFileName),
            SamplePaths    = make_set(FolderPath, 5),
            EncryptedExts  = make_set(tostring(extract(@"\.([A-Za-z0-9]+)\.rhysida$", 1, FileName)), 10)
          by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, Bucket
| where EncryptedFiles > EncryptionBurstThreshold or NoteDropped > 0
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let WindowMinutes = 5m;
let EncryptionBurstThreshold = 50;
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
| where TargetFileName endswith ".rhysida"
     or (TargetFileName =~ "CriticalBreachDetected.pdf" and TargetFilePath !has "\\Windows\\")
| extend Bucket = bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)
| summarize EncryptedFiles = countif(TargetFileName endswith ".rhysida"),
            NoteDropped    = countif(TargetFileName =~ "CriticalBreachDetected.pdf"),
            FirstSeen      = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen       = max(TimeGenerated),
            Encryptor      = any(ActingProcessName),
            EncryptorCmd   = any(ActingProcessCommandLine),
            SamplePaths    = make_set(TargetFilePath, 5)
          by DvcHostname, ActorUsername, Bucket
| where EncryptedFiles > EncryptionBurstThreshold or NoteDropped > 0
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Rhysida ransom note + .rhysida extension write
id: 1c8a7b3c-3aef-44e1-9c4e-rhysida0002
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of the Rhysida ransomware ransom note CriticalBreachDetected.pdf or files with the .rhysida extension on disk.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-319a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.rhysida'
  selection_note:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\CriticalBreachDetected.pdf'
  condition: selection_ext or selection_note
falsepositives:
  - Tabletop / purple-team test runs of the ransom note PDF (correlate with engagement window)
level: critical
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten (TargetFileName=/\.rhysida$/i OR TargetFileName=/\\CriticalBreachDetected\.pdf$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName], function=[count(as=file_count), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen), collect(TargetFileName, limit=10, separator=" || ")])
| (file_count > 50 OR collect_TargetFileName=/CriticalBreachDetected/i)
ucs.rationale: The .rhysida extension and CriticalBreachDetected.pdf ransom note are both verbatim IOCs from CISA AA23-319A and Microsoft's Vice Society/Rhysida tracking — neither overlaps with other big-game crews. LockBit drops <random>.README.txt, BlackCat drops RECOVER-<id>-FILES.txt, Akira drops akira_readme.txt; only Rhysida ships CriticalBreachDetected.pdf, so a single hit on the note alone is alert-worth
_sigma_issues: sigma parse error: Sigma rule identifier must be an UUID
